purpose: Define explicit bounded exceptions for specific validation rules where the Contract Format permits an exception, preventing informal prose waivers from turning failures into passes.

topics.name: Validation Exception and Waiver
topics.purpose: Define explicit bounded exceptions for specific validation rules where the Contract Format permits an exception, preventing informal prose waivers from turning failures into passes.

semantics.permission_rule: Only rules explicitly marked exception-capable may be waived.
semantics.scope_rule: Exception applies only to the exact declared target/rule/scope.
semantics.authority_rule: Exception requires explicit authorized approval identity/policy.
semantics.expiry_rule: Exception is bounded by expiry or review condition.
semantics.visibility_rule: Validation results preserve applied exception refs and original underlying findings.
semantics.lock_rule: Exception may contribute to lock eligibility only when the owning lock/conformance policy explicitly permits it.
semantics.no_prose_rule: Free-form documentation alone never acts as an exception.

invariants.rule: Validation outcomes, findings, exceptions, evidence, baselines and release decisions are explicit machine-readable facts and never silently rewrite source semantics.

hard_gates.condition: exception lacks authority or expiry/review condition
underlying finding disappears when exception applies
prose note treated as machine-valid waiver
expired exception still used for pass/lock

references.purpose: Exceptions affect lock eligibility only under explicit policy.
